title: Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI hedge fund collapses after margin calls
excerpt: The fund, which peaked at $45 billion this month, was forced to sell leveraged bets on AI infrastructure stocks to Ken Griffin's Citadel at a discount
content_html:
Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, lost roughly $35 billion in assets after margin calls from its prime brokers forced a distressed sale of its publicly traded holdings to Ken Griffin's Citadel, according to CNBC.

The fund, which peaked at $45 billion at the start of July, saw its holdings drop to roughly $10 billion by Thursday after Citadel acquired its leveraged stock positions — among them SK Hynix and CoreWeave — at below-market prices, according to CNBC, citing people with knowledge of the situation. Prime brokers Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan Chase had been working with the fund to meet margin requirements ahead of the sale.

Situational Awareness took losses on bullish bets in AI infrastructure names at the same time that bearish wagers on software companies like Adobe went the wrong way. Nebius Group, Sandisk, Micron, and CoreWeave — the fund's top disclosed positions as of the first quarter — have each shed more than 35% of their value this month. The fund had used as much as 400% leverage.

Before this month's decline, the fund had posted gains of more than 1,000% since its inception in July 2024, according to the Wall Street Journal.

Before the Citadel transaction, roughly two-thirds of the fund's portfolio consisted of public equity positions on both the long and short side, with the balance concentrated in private holdings, chiefly its Anthropic investment. A spokesman for the firm said that reports it was marketing its Anthropic stake were not accurate.

Jerry Diao, who runs a Wall Street coaching firm, said that many observers had expected the fund to eventually run into trouble. "A lot of people saw this blow-up as a matter of not if, but when," Diao said. "Maybe his views on AI are correct in the long run, but in the public markets, you have to be prepared for the short-term."

Aschenbrenner, who is 25 years old, structured the fund around his conviction that more capable AI systems would drive enormous demand for semiconductors, memory, data centers, and power infrastructure — a thesis he developed in a widely circulated 2024 essay written after his departure from OpenAI. His early backers included Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison, former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman, and investor Daniel Gross.

The fund's collapse comes as Aschenbrenner is scheduled to marry Avital Balwit, chief of staff for Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, this weekend.

content_html_zh:
据 CNBC 报道，利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 的对冲基金 Situational Awareness 在其主要经纪商追加保证金后，被迫将其公开交易的股票出售给肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 的 Citadel，导致其资产损失约 350 亿美元。

据 CNBC 援引知情人士的消息称，该基金在 7 月初达到了 450 亿美元的峰值，在 Citadel 以低于市场价格收购其杠杆股票头寸（其中包括 SK Hynix 和 CoreWeave）后，到周四，该基金的持股量已降至约 100 亿美元。 主要经纪商美国银行、高盛和摩根大通一直在与该基金合作，以满足出售前的保证金要求。

态势感知公司因看涨人工智能基础设施名称而蒙受损失，同时看空 Adob​​e 等软件公司却出现了错误。 截至第一季度，该基金披露的头寸最多的 Nebius Group、Sandisk、Micron 和 CoreWeave 本月价值均缩水超过 35%。 该基金使用了高达400%的杠杆。

据《华尔街日报》报道，在本月下跌之前，该基金自 2024 年 7 月成立以来的涨幅已超过 1,000%。

在 Citadel 交易之前，该基金投资组合的大约三分之二由多头和空头的公共股票头寸组成，余额集中在私人持股上，主要是其 Anthropic 投资。 该公司的一位发言人表示，有关其推销其 Anthropic 股份的报道并不准确。

华尔街一家辅导公司的经营者杰里·刁(Jerry Diao)表示，许多观察人士都预计该基金最终会陷入困境。 “很多人认为这次爆发不是是否会发生的问题，而是何时发生的问题，”刁说。 “也许从长远来看，他对人工智能的看法是正确的，但在公开市场上，你必须为短期做好准备。”

25 岁的阿申布伦纳 (Aschenbrenner) 围绕自己的信念构建了该基金，即更强大的人工智能系统将推动对半导体、内存、数据中心和电力基础设施的巨大需求——这是他在离开 OpenAI 后于 2024 年发表的一篇广为流传的文章中提出的论点。 他的早期支持者包括 Stripe 联合创始人 Patrick 和 John Collison、GitHub 前首席执行官 Nat Friedman 以及投资者 Daniel Gross。

该基金崩溃之际，阿申布伦纳计划于本周末与 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的幕僚长阿维塔尔·巴尔维特 (Avital Balwit) 结婚。
